answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in fable, checked in pearl, and signal publishes each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 20 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 2099 identities would post 680 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
